proposals.evidence: Turner specifically derives Punjabi/Lahnda heṭh, Bhojpuri heṭhā̃ and Gujarati heṭhe below from adhiṣṭāt through MIA heṭṭha/hiṭṭha. The Gujari and Vasavi survey forms preserve the retroflex-t adverb family with variable initial h and final nasal/vowel endings; the slash alternatives share this history. The distinct adhastāt first branch is not selected.
